_readme.what: Lone "meat" blocks in structure templates, marked to be swapped for Architect's Palette fish blocks standing upright when the structure is placed. Written by python3 tools/meat_block_scan.py (do not edit by hand: rerun it). A lone block has no neighbour of the same block in the template.
_readme.entries: template id -> [{pos: [x, y, z] in the template, from: block id there, to: {Name, Properties}}]. A swap applies only when the template still has `from` at `pos` (a mod update that moves things skips it).
_readme.applied by: patcherMod worldgen/TemplateBlockSwaps: each marked template is patched once when it loads (every rotation and every structure using it get the new block). Read at every world load; new chunks only. Switch: CEConfig [worldgen.systems] templateBlockSwaps.
